title: Derived internal Hom into a complete object on a ringed site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site small in the module universe, let $\mathcal O$ be a sheaf of commutative rings, and let $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O$ be an ideal subsheaf. Use the unbounded derived category $D(\mathcal O)$ of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the derived internal Hom $H=R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O}$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], and restriction to slice ringed sites [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Call $N\in D(\mathcal O)$ locally derived $\mathcal I$-complete if for every object $U$ and every $f\in\mathcal I(U)$ one has $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_U}(\mathcal O_U[1/f],N|_U)=0$ [def-weil-pbc-locally-derived-ringed-ideal-complete]; here $\mathcal O_U[1/f]$ is sheafified sectionwise localization [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-section-localization]. For every $K\in D(\mathcal O)$ and every locally derived $\mathcal I$-complete $N$, the object $H(K,N)$ is locally derived $\mathcal I$-complete. No boundedness, finite-generation, finite-type-ideal, or flatness hypothesis is imposed.
